concerns.text: T008 (Total Records Count) and T009 (CBNRM Proxy Fetch) are listed as tasks but marked with [ ] (incomplete) and lack implementation details. SC-001 requires measuring the proportion of merged records against the total available (T008). FR-001 requires fetching the specific CBNRM proxy (T009). Without completed tasks for these foundational data verification steps, the downstream tasks (T012, T014, T015) cannot function, and SC-001/FR-001 cannot be satisfied.

T023 (Fixed-Effects Regression), T024 (Sensitivity Analysis), T025 (Non-linearity), T050 (Test Count), and T051 (FDR Correction) are marked [ ] (incomplete). FR-003, FR-006, FR-008, and SC-005 depend on these. Specifically, T051 (FDR) depends on T050 (Test Count) which is also incomplete. The plan requires these to be implemented to satisfy the statistical thresholds in Constitution Principle VII.

T036 (Report Generation) is marked [ ] (incomplete). It depends on T015 (Coverage Rate), T024 (Sensitivity Coefficients), and T027 (Associational Flag). Since T024 and T027 are also incomplete (or T027 is missing entirely as a task), the report cannot be generated, leaving FR-004 (Associational Label) and SC-005 (Sensitivity) unverified.

T003 (Linting/Formatting) and T007 (Pytest Setup) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene) require a runnable, validated environment. Without these tasks being completed, the project cannot meet the reproducibility standards mandated by the Constitution.

T008 and T009 are listed under 'Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)' but are marked as incomplete tasks. The text describes them as 'Verify and Fetch' but provides no implementation steps or file paths, unlike T011-T016. This creates a gap in the task definition for critical data acquisition steps required by FR-001 and SC-001.

T027 (Associational Flag) is listed as a task but has no checkbox status (unchecked [ ] implied or missing). It is critical for FR-004. The task description is present but the implementation status is ambiguous compared to other tasks.
